questions.text: Which of the following are true about Gantt Charts?
options: Each bar represents an employee's working hours
The length of a bar represents task duration
Gantt charts show task dependencies through arrows
Gantt charts visually represent the schedule of tasks over time
correct_answer: The length of a bar represents task duration
Gantt charts visually represent the schedule of tasks over time

Ravi modified three files (file1, file2, and file3) in his local Git repository. Two of them (file1 and file2) are ready to be committed, but one was just for testing and should not be committed. Which sequence of commands should Ravi use to commit only the two ready files?
